explanation: Te-li-Ssu's § Background: "After the loss to the Japanese at the Battle of Nanshan, the Russian Viceroy Yevgeni Alekseyev came under extreme political pressure to make a military advance to prevent the complete encirclement of Port Arthur." The article then follows that pressure to the Tsar's decision and to this battle: "General Kuropatkin was reluctantly forced to mount an offensive from Liaoyang in the general direction of Port Arthur ... Lieutenant-General Georgii Stackelberg ... was chosen for the mission." An offensive mounted in answer to a defeat is `reacted-to` in this atlas's five types, which is the weaker of the two readings the article allows. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
